justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs whose dominant motif is a large profile quadruped rendered in outline with straight stick-like legs, and both appear to combine that beast with human/anthropomorphic elements above it. But A shows a fully organised two-register composition — a row of three armed, shielded warriors over a mounted rider with a serpent-like creature beneath, all enclosed by a continuous plaited border — while B is a single sparse field of thin incised outlines with no framing, no register division, no weaponry and no clear rider, so the specific narrative scheme is not shared.
